outlook: Soybeans led Friday's grain trade, with January futures up about 13 cents to near $12.21 and soybean meal up nearly $9, as limited farmer selling pushed some Midwest crushers to raise cash basis bids. December corn slipped 4.5 cents to about $4.345 even as EPA data showed October ethanol blending credits rose to 1.26 billion. Minneapolis December spring wheat fell about 3 cents to $6.38 and Chicago wheat lost 4 cents to $5.74, as Argentina's harvest estimate rose to 24 million tonnes, its second-largest on record, outweighing a large Russian strike on Ukraine's power grid. ICE January canola was nearly unchanged at C$776.80, and Minneapolis cash bids below are from Thursday's final report.

news.title: Wheat rallies as soybeans, corn finish mixed
